remarks: Rent includes heat, hot water & parking. This pet-friendly apartment is a privatey situated, top floor, corner apartment tucked away in the heart of downtown Stamford and offers sunny, bright & large space with high 9' ceilings, hardwood floors throughout, character & charm! Welcome to 70 Strawberry Hill, an enchanting mid-rise apartment community set back from the road on picturesque grounds enhanced with courtyards of flowers, gardens & trees! Enjoy 1200+ square feet, a cool Euro-inspired kitchen, generous living & separate dining area, 9' ceilings, hardwood floors & windows galore. The Primary bedroom has a private bath w/shower stall. The second bedroom is also very large! On site super. Common area laundry & storage available on lower level. Pet friendly, 1-dog permitted, must be 20 lbs. and per owner & management discretion. Enjoy quality space steps to all downtown Stamford attractions & conveniences. Tenant just vacated, some minor work in progress. Will be perfectly presented to our new resident!
